description: End-to-end entitlement and licensing workflow for B2B SD-WAN services, from eligibility assessment through entitlement creation, activation, modification, quota management, and rollback.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the B2B customer (enterprise account).

entitlement_id.description: Unique identifier for an SD-WAN entitlement record.

license_pack_id.description: Identifier of a license pack SKU or logical product bundle.

sdwan_site_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN site/location under the customer.

order_id.description: Identifier of a commercial or internal order associated with the entitlement.

change_request_id.description: Identifier of a pending or completed entitlement change request.

activation_batch_id.description: Identifier of a batch activation job for entitlements or licenses.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: check_customer_entitlement_eligibility
functions.description: Evaluate whether a customer is eligible for SD-WAN entitlements based on contract, profile, and technical constraints.

traffic_classes.description: Desired traffic classes and QoS policies.

max_sites.description: Maximum sites the customer intends to onboard.

contract_context.description: Optional contract and commercial context used for eligibility.

validation_options.description: Controls the depth and type of checks performed.

functions.returns: Eligibility result with allowed service tiers, max quotas, and any blocking reasons or recommendations.

functions.name: list_entitlements
functions.description: List existing SD-WAN entitlements for a customer with filtering and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of entitlements for the customer, optionally including usage summaries, sites, license packs, and pending changes.

functions.name: get_entitlement_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details of a specific SD-WAN entitlement, including quotas, sites, and license assignments.
functions.returns: Complete entitlement record with optional related objects, such as sites, license packs, usage, and change history.

functions.name: create_entitlement
functions.description: Create a new SD-WAN entitlement for a customer, with initial quotas and license packs.

order_id.description: Commercial order associated with the entitlement.

service_profile.description: Definition of the entitled SD-WAN service.

quota_definition.description: Initial entitlement quotas for sites and bandwidth.

license_packs.description: Initial license packs to allocate under this entitlement.

functions.returns: New entitlement_id with initial status (usually 'draft' or 'pending_activation') and summary of created quotas and license packs.

functions.name: plan_entitlement_change
functions.description: Create a change request to modify quotas, license packs, or service tier for an existing entitlement.

requested_changes.description: Details of requested changes. Optional sub-objects depending on change_request_type.

license_pack_modifications.description: Requested additions/removals/quantity changes for license packs.

effective_date.description: Requested effective date/time for the change.

requested_by.description: User or system initiating the change.

functions.returns: A new change_request_id with a preliminary impact assessment and status (e.g., 'pending_approval', 'pending_validation').

functions.name: validate_entitlement_quota
functions.description: Validate that requested or current quotas do not exceed contractual or platform limits, and check per-site availability.

sites_to_validate.description: Optional list of sites and requested bandwidths to validate against quotas.

simulate_after_change_request_id.description: Optionally validate quotas assuming a particular change request is applied.

functions.returns: Validation report indicating whether quotas are within limits, per-site validation results, and recommended adjustments if invalid.

functions.name: activate_entitlement_batch
functions.description: Trigger activation of one or more entitlements and/or associated license packs in a batch job.

entitlement_ids.description: List of entitlement IDs to activate in this batch.

license_pack_scope.description: Defines which license packs within the entitlements should be activated.

functions.returns: activation_batch_id with initial activation status per entitlement and any scheduling details.

functions.name: get_activation_batch_status
functions.description: Retrieve the status and results of an entitlement or license activation batch.
functions.returns: Activation batch summary with overall status, per-entitlement and per-license-pack results, and any error details.

functions.name: update_entitlement_status
functions.description: Update the lifecycle status of an entitlement (e.g., suspend, reinstate, terminate) with reason codes.
functions.returns: Updated entitlement record with new status, timestamps, and applied options.

functions.name: allocate_site_licenses
functions.description: Allocate or reallocate SD-WAN license capacity to individual sites under an entitlement.

bandwidth_mbps.description: Allocated bandwidth for this site from entitlement quota.

dry_run.description: If true, do not persist changes; only return impact analysis.

functions.returns: Per-site allocation results, updated available quota, and any validation errors or overbooking warnings.

functions.name: get_entitlement_usage_and_quota
functions.description: Retrieve current usage vs. entitlement quotas at both global and site levels.

time_window.description: Optional time window for usage statistics.

items.description: List of sdwan_site_id to limit the usage query.

functions.returns: Usage and quota metrics for the entitlement, optionally broken down by site, license pack, and time window.

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_entitlement_change
functions.description: Cancel a pending change request or rollback a recently applied entitlement change in case of errors or customer request.
functions.returns: Rollback or cancellation result, including reverted fields, impacted entitlements/sites, and any residual inconsistencies.

functions.name: retry_failed_entitlement_operation
functions.description: Retry a failed entitlement-related operation such as activation, allocation, or status update with adjustable retry parameters.

operation_reference.description: Identifies the failed operation to retry.

retry_strategy.description: Controls how the retry is performed.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameters to override for the retry (e.g., different scheduled_time, modified allocation options).

reason.description: Free-text reason or context for the retry.

functions.returns: Retry job status with new attempt identifiers, immediate validation of feasibility, and first attempt outcome if executed synchronously.

functions.name: entitlement_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import entitlement entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: entitlement_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many entitlement entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: entitlement_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many entitlement entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: entitlement_bulk_export
functions.description: Export entitlement entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: entitlement_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across entitlement entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: entitlement_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for entitlement events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: entitlement_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for entitlement notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: entitlement_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more entitlement entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: entitlement_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to entitlement on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: entitlement_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a entitlement operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: entitlement_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending entitlement change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: entitlement_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending entitlement approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: entitlement_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a entitlement entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: entitlement_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a entitlement entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: entitlement_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a entitlement entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: entitlement_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a entitlement entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: entitlement_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for entitlement activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: entitlement_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a entitlement view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: entitlement_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to entitlement entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: entitlement_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given entitlement payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: entitlement_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a entitlement entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: entitlement_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a entitlement entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
